sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Removes the ad shown on launch and the ads in the offer list and highlights.
Removes the app's access to your location while it is closed or in the background.
Stops the app from scanning for Bluetooth devices and beacons, and hides paired devices.
Stops Foursquare's Movement SDK, which records the places you visit in the background and reports them with your user ID, gender, and birthday.
Lets Android darken the app while the phone is in dark mode. Android picks the colors, so some screens may look different from a designed dark theme.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Signs in with Google through GmsCore instead of Google Play services.
Hides the cell towers your phone sees from the app.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Removes the sign-up sheet, the welcome walkthrough, the notification and Instant Offers prompts, the location notice, marketing messages, and the card that asks you to rate the app.
Hides nearby Wi-Fi networks and the name of your network from the app.
Replaces the gas maps, which are blank in a patched app because Google Maps rejects its key, with OpenStreetMap maps and a list of the offers. The details screen gets a Directions button.
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
Opens store links without affiliate tags or click tracking. Checkout 51 online cash back needs those, so it stops working.
